text_to_image_prompt: Premium refined semi-realistic 2.5D/3D character render, sculpted beautiful face, delicate skin microtexture and subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, richly detailed fabric and metal physically based materials. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An adult woman with sleek black hair in a neat updo decorated with ivory satin bows, violet eyes, pale neutral skin, a softly refined oval face and soft pink lips. Long pearl and crystal drop earrings and an ivory gathered evening gown with delicate lace details. Elegant restrained expression. Continue the ivory satin gathered evening gown into a full opaque floor-length A-line skirt, off-shoulder gathered short sleeves, floral pearl clasps and ivory low heels. Tall healthy 176 cm slender build. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
